extraction.notes: The official registration platform says it is planning the 2027 summer camp program, but no youth dates, prices, individual sessions or registration milestones were found. The youth page describes kids camps and teen weekend workshops together for ages 3–17; separate age limits are not posted. General workshop schedules, fees and summer 2027 scholarship deadlines apply to adults aged 18 or older and were not transferred to youth cards. Website pages returned empty bodies when opened with the browser; official indexed text and the supplied fetched pages were readable.
